title: Enterprise Legacy Code Modernization Factory (COBOL/PL-SQL/Java 8 -> Cloud-Native Java 21) Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Naive Whole-File LLM Prompt Translation (No AST DAG, No Golden Tape)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 44% compile failures & 31.5% COMP-3 rounding/cursor bugs ($620K rework)

tiers.name: Tier 2: Manual IDE Chat/Copilot Snippet Rewrite Without Automated Factory
tiers.verdict: Takes 14.5 months per 500K LOC; engineers spend 75% of time reverse-engineering specs

tiers.name: Tier 3: Agentic Code + LLM-Generated Unit Tests (Self-Graded Homework)
tiers.verdict: LLM bakes its own misinterpretation of COBOL/PL-SQL edge cases into the unit test assertions!

tiers.name: Tier 4: AST Leaf-First Slicer + COMP-3 BigDecimal Guard + 10K Golden I/O Tape Harness + Shadowing
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 99.8% I/O equivalence, 2.4-month delivery (6x faster) & -86.3% TCO ($85K)
